proposedContracts.name: records the native gray and packed-alpha conversions that fall outside the negotiation table
proposedContracts.scope: native gray->yuvj444p and alpha RGB->yuva444p are outside the table

notes: All five paths are flagged; actor and timed are proven through createFrameActors and the timed CLI backend.

Status is partial: native auto-converts gray to yuvj444p and packed alpha RGB to yuva444p. Matching that needs a shared edit, which was not made: add yuvj444p and yuva444p to negotiationOrder/descriptors in packages/avfilter/src/video-ops/formats.ts and pixelLayout, or add a descriptor hook that sees the pre-conversion source format so swapuv can refuse those sources. Until then, swapuv on those inputs runs but diverges from native. The registry examples therefore start with an explicit format=.
The spec asked for gray/rgba sources. They were replaced by rgb24/gbrp in the byte comparisons because of the gap, and the gap itself is pinned by a native test.
Setup durations: submodule 51s, npm ci 9s, reference:build 198s.
Baseline: typecheck, lint and boundaries clean; 13 unit failures (FLAC artifacts, resample-checkpoint macOS digests), unchanged after the change.
